TextView.android:text:
1. Log in with your email and password, or tap Continue with Google.

2. New accounts must be approved by an administrator before you can log in.

3. Tap ☰ to open the menu. Staff can view Programs, log attendance and donate.

4. Log Attendance: pick a session, mark each student Present, Absent or Excused, then tap Save register.

5. Donate: enter your details and amount, then tap Donate Now to get your receipt.

6. Administrators also register and enrol students, approve or close programs, add sessions, allocate a Coordinator as helper staff, and manage donations, reports and user approvals. A helper Coordinator can add sessions and record performance for the program they were allocated to.

7. Settings: choose dark or light theme, large text, and whether the banner slider shows. Tap Save settings.

8. Tap Logout in the banner or in Settings to sign out.

If you see 'Cannot reach server', check your internet connection and that the website is running.
